requirement_text: The application and its options will be in US English and Unicode format for globalization support.
user_story: As an international user, I want the application and its options to be in US English and Unicode format, so that it supports globalization.
technical_task: Provide the application and its options in US English, using Unicode for text.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when it is displayed, then the application and its options are in US English.
Given text entered or displayed, when it is stored, then it is in Unicode format.

requirement_text: The system shall allow members to write articles for the site with an associated graphic.
user_story: As a member, I want to write articles for the site with an associated graphic, so that I can share content with other visitors.
technical_task: Allow members to write articles and attach a graphic to each article.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in member, when the member writes an article, then the article is saved for the site.
Given an article, when the member associates a graphic with it, then the graphic is saved with the article.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to use registries or directories to uniquely identify providers for the provision of care.
user_story: As a care coordinator, I want to use registries or directories to uniquely identify providers, so that care is directed to the right provider.
technical_task: Support registries or directories that uniquely identify providers for the provision of care.
acceptance_criteria: Given a provider, when it is looked up in a registry or directory, then it is uniquely identified.
Given two different providers, when both are looked up, then each has a different identity.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to compare two versions of a score side-by-side, differentiated by measure.
user_story: As a musician, I want to compare two versions of a score side by side, differentiated by measure, so that I can see what changed.
technical_task: Display two versions of a score side by side with differences shown by measure.
acceptance_criteria: Given two versions of a score, when the user opens the comparison, then both are shown side by side.
Given a measure that differs between the versions, when the comparison is shown, then the difference is indicated for that measure.

requirement_text: User shall not be able to view other users' details for privacy and security reasons.
user_story: As a user, I want other users not to be able to view my details, so that my privacy and security are protected.
technical_task: Prevent a user from viewing the details of other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when one tries to view the other's details, then access is not allowed.
Given a user, when the user opens their own details, then they are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion keeps own details viewable.

requirement_text: The system shall allow repository managers to associate content files with objects and components.
user_story: As a repository manager, I want to associate content files with objects and components, so that files are linked to what they belong to.
technical_task: Provide a function to associate content files with objects and with components.
acceptance_criteria: Given a content file and an object, when the repository manager associates them, then the file is linked to the object.
Given a content file and a component, when the repository manager associates them, then the file is linked to the component.

requirement_text: The system shall function as a reusable semester-to-semester application for returning students, offering automatic class schedule updates and integration with the Radford University mobile app.
user_story: As a returning student, I want to reuse the application from semester to semester with automatic class schedule updates and integration with the Radford University mobile app, so that I don't have to set it up again.
technical_task: Build a reusable application that updates class schedules automatically each semester and integrates with the Radford University mobile app.
acceptance_criteria: Given a returning student in a new semester, when the semester starts, then the class schedule is updated automatically.
Given the Radford University mobile app, when the student uses the application, then the application is integrated with the app.
rationale: Role assumed: returning student. The integration details are not given.

requirement_text: Deposit envelopes shall be 9 inches long and 4 inches wide.
user_story: As a bank teller, I want deposit envelopes to be 9 inches long and 4 inches wide, so that they fit the deposit equipment.
technical_task: Produce deposit envelopes that are 9 inches long and 4 inches wide.
acceptance_criteria: Given a deposit envelope, when its length is measured, then it is 9 inches.
Given a deposit envelope, when its width is measured, then it is 4 inches.
rationale: Role assumed: bank teller. The reason for the size is inferred.

requirement_text: Licensed Health Care Professional (LHCP): A licensed health care professional that is allowed by a particular patient to view all approved medical records.
rationale: The sentence defines a role and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system do for an LHCP?
Is this a definition or a requirement?

requirement_text: After submitting the complaint, the system shall display a validation form for every user.
user_story: As a complainant, I want a validation form displayed after I submit a complaint, so that I can confirm the submission.
technical_task: Display a validation form to every user after a complaint is submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user submits a complaint, when the submission completes, then a validation form is displayed.
Given any other user submits a complaint, when the submission completes, then that user also sees a validation form.
rationale: Role assumed: complainant. What the validation form contains is not described.

requirement_text: Users shall select the recruitment option and choose Forms for Certificates.
user_story: As a user, I want to select the recruitment option and choose Forms for Certificates, so that I can reach the right forms.
technical_task: Let users choose the recruitment option and then select Forms for Certificates.
acceptance_criteria: Given the menu, when the user selects the recruitment option, then Forms for Certificates can be chosen.
Given the recruitment option is open, when the user chooses Forms for Certificates, then those forms are opened.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall complete the change from one vehicle mode to the next within 1.02 seconds. There is up to a full major frame from notification of an impending mode change to acting on it in minor frame 0 of the next major frame plus the time it takes during the next minor frame 0 to switch tasking.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS020] complete the change from one vehicle mode to the next within 1.02 seconds. There is up to a full major frame from notification of an impending mode change to acting on it in minor frame 0 of the next major frame plus the time it takes during the next minor frame 0 to switch tasking.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to complete the change from one vehicle mode to the next within 1.02 seconds, so that mode changes are timely.
technical_task: Make the scheduler complete a vehicle mode change within 1.02 seconds, accounting for up to a full major frame from notification to acting on it in minor frame 0 of the next major frame plus the switching time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vehicle mode change, when the scheduler performs it, then the change completes within 1.02 seconds.
Given a notification of an impending mode change, when the next major frame starts, then the scheduler acts on it in minor frame 0 and switches tasking.

requirement_text: Checks received from insurance companies can be entered here and distributed to cover the appropriate encounters.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to enter checks received from insurance companies and distribute them to cover the right encounters, so that payments are applied correctly.
technical_task: Provide a screen to enter insurance company checks and distribute their amounts across the appropriate encounters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a check from an insurance company, when the clerk enters it, then the check is recorded.
Given a recorded check, when the clerk distributes it, then it is applied to the appropriate encounters.

requirement_text: User shall be able to collect and log the dispensed amount.
user_story: As a customer, I want to collect and log the dispensed amount, so that I have a record of what was dispensed.
technical_task: Allow users to collect the dispensed amount and record it in a log.
acceptance_criteria: Given an amount has been dispensed, when the user collects it, then the collection is possible.
Given the dispensed amount, when the user logs it, then the amount is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. What is dispensed is not described.

requirement_text: The system shall identify potentially faulty sensor data based on a sensor-specific number of consecutive missed readings due to communication issues.
user_story: As a system operator, I want potentially faulty sensor data to be identified from a sensor-specific number of consecutive missed readings, so that communication problems are noticed.
technical_task: Flag sensor data as potentially faulty after a sensor-specific number of consecutive missed readings caused by communication issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sensor with a configured number of consecutive missed readings, when that number is reached due to communication issues, then its data is identified as potentially faulty.
Given fewer consecutive missed readings than the configured number, when data is evaluated, then it is not flagged.
rationale: Role assumed: system operator. The count per sensor is not given.

requirement_text: It must be guaranteed that the CPU peak load during crash algorithm in worst case is max. 90%.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a guarantee that the CPU peak load during the crash algorithm is at most 90% in the worst case, so that the CPU has headroom.
technical_task: Limit CPU peak load during the crash algorithm to a maximum of 90% in the worst case.
acceptance_criteria: Given the crash algorithm runs in the worst case, when CPU peak load is measured, then it is at most 90%.
Given the crash algorithm, when CPU peak load is measured in any case, then it never exceeds 90%.

requirement_text: The storage (i.e., non-operating) temperature range for the flight NE shall be from -30 °C to 60 °C.
requirement_text_raw: The storage (i.e., non-operating) temperature range for the flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.1.3) be from -30 °C to 60 °C.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE storage temperature range to be from -30 °C to 60 °C, so that it survives storage conditions.
technical_task: Qualify the flight NE for a non-operating storage temperature range of -30 °C to 60 °C.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE stored at -30 °C, when it is later powered on, then it works.
Given the flight NE stored at 60 °C, when it is later powered on, then it works.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The unit symbol in the source text is garbled and read as degrees Celsius.

requirement_text: Administrators shall be able to add buildings.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add buildings, so that they are available in the system.
technical_task: Allow administrators to add buildings.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator adds a building, then the building is saved.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to add a building, then it is not allowed.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall provide an admin panel for content management, allowing admins to add, edit, or delete projects and tutorials.
user_story: As an admin, I want an admin panel to add, edit or delete projects and tutorials, so that I can manage the content.
technical_task: Build an admin panel for Crafty kids corner with add, edit and delete for projects and tutorials.
acceptance_criteria: Given the admin panel, when an admin adds a project or tutorial, then it is saved.
Given an existing project or tutorial, when an admin edits or deletes it, then the change is applied.

requirement_text: The system shall allow starting a round by entering an item in a multi-line text field.
user_story: As a team member, I want to start a round by entering an item in a multi-line text field, so that I can describe what to estimate.
technical_task: Provide a multi-line text field for entering an item to start a round.
acceptance_criteria: Given the start-round screen, when the user enters an item in the multi-line text field and submits, then a round is started.
Given an item with several lines, when it is entered, then all lines are accepted in the field.

requirement_text: Customers shall receive order details once the order is picked up.
user_story: As a customer, I want to receive my order details when the order is picked up, so that I have a record.
technical_task: Send order details to the customer once the order is picked up.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order that has been picked up, when the pickup is recorded, then the customer receives the order details.
Given an order not yet picked up, when time passes, then the customer does not receive the pickup order details.
rationale: Role stated: customer. The delivery channel is not stated.

requirement_text: Enter the correct data to complete the form and click 'Save'.
rationale: The sentence reads as an instruction to a user rather than a system requirement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or user guidance?
Which form is meant and what is the correct data?

requirement_text: System shall be able to efficiently write client-side data to the disk and retrieve database data on the server side, with a target time of approximately 0.5 seconds for each operation.
user_story: As a user, I want client-side data written to disk and server data retrieved efficiently, with a target of approximately 0.5 seconds per operation, so that the system feels fast.
technical_task: Write client-side data to disk and retrieve database data on the server side with a target time of approximately 0.5 seconds for each operation.
acceptance_criteria: Given client-side data, when it is written to disk, then the operation takes approximately 0.5 seconds or less.
Given database data on the server, when it is retrieved, then the operation takes approximately 0.5 seconds or less.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Efficiently" is covered by the 0.5 second target.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall be able to accommodate power up of all 5 channels and maintain all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS201] be able to accommodate power up of all 5 channels and maintain all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to power up all 5 channels and keep all 5 NEs active when there are no failures, so that full redundancy is available.
technical_task: Support power-up of all 5 channels in Redundancy Management and keep all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given no failures, when all 5 channels are powered up, then Redundancy Management accommodates the power-up.
Given all 5 channels are powered up with no failures, when the system runs, then all 5 NEs stay active.

requirement_text: The product shall provide Error Tracking Services.
rationale: "Error Tracking Services" is named without describing what they must do.
clarification_questions: What must an Error Tracking Service do (record, notify, report)?

requirement_text: The applications memory usage on the mobile operating system should ideally be below 10 MB, with a strict limit of 20 MB during operation.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want the application's memory usage to ideally stay below 10 MB with a strict limit of 20 MB, so that it does not slow my phone.
technical_task: Keep the application's memory usage below 10 MB where possible and never above 20 MB during operation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application is running, when memory usage is measured, then it does not exceed 20 MB.
Given the application is running, when memory usage is measured, then it is ideally below 10 MB.
rationale: Role assumed: mobile user. The 10 MB value is a goal and the 20 MB value is the limit.

requirement_text: A user shall be able to optionally provide a restaurant description, menu, type, picture, and mobile number to enhance their listing.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want to optionally add a description, menu, type, picture and mobile number, so that my listing is more informative.
technical_task: Add optional fields for restaurant description, menu, type, picture and mobile number to a listing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a listing, when the user fills in the optional fields, then the description, menu, type, picture and mobile number are saved.
Given a listing, when the user leaves the optional fields empty, then the listing is still saved.

requirement_text: Upon touching the how to play button on the menu screen, the how to play screen shall be displayed, and users shall be able to see screenshots of tutorial screens by sliding the windows.
user_story: As a player, I want the how to play screen to open when I touch the how to play button and to slide through screenshots of the tutorial, so that I can learn the game.
technical_task: Open the how to play screen from the how to play button on the menu screen and let users slide the windows to see tutorial screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Given the menu screen, when the user touches the how to play button, then the how to play screen is displayed.
Given the how to play screen, when the user slides the windows, then screenshots of tutorial screens are shown.

requirement_text: The application should ideally use less than 10 MB of storage space, with a hard limit of 20 MB.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want the application to use ideally less than 10 MB of storage and never more than 20 MB, so that it leaves space on my device.
technical_task: Limit the application's storage use to less than 10 MB as a goal and to 20 MB as a hard limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the installed application, when its storage use is measured, then it does not exceed 20 MB.
Given the installed application, when its storage use is measured, then it is ideally less than 10 MB.

requirement_text: The system shall integrate with Symplectic Elements for bidirectional communication (if needed).
user_story: As a research administrator, I want the system to integrate with Symplectic Elements for bidirectional communication when needed, so that data can flow both ways.
technical_task: Integrate the system with Symplectic Elements to support communication in both directions where it is needed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the integration is needed, when data changes in the system, then it can be sent to Symplectic Elements.
Given the integration is needed, when data changes in Symplectic Elements, then it can be received by the system.
rationale: Role assumed: research administrator. When the integration is needed is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability for the administrator to track user behavior as well as database utilization.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to track user behavior and database utilization, so that I can see how the system is used.
technical_task: Provide administrators with tracking of user behavior and database utilization.
acceptance_criteria: Given user activity, when an administrator opens the tracking view, then user behavior is shown.
Given the database in use, when an administrator opens the tracking view, then database utilization is shown.

requirement_text: If the SEP API call is made prior to actual separation, the call shall return zero (0).
requirement_text_raw: If the SEP API call is made prior to actual separation, the call shall (3.3.10.27) return zero (0).
user_story: As a software developer, I want the SEP API call to return zero (0) when it is made before actual separation, so that I can tell separation has not happened.
technical_task: Return zero (0) from the SEP API call when it is made before actual separation.
acceptance_criteria: Given actual separation has not occurred, when the SEP API call is made, then it returns zero (0).
Given the SEP API call returns zero (0), when the caller checks the result, then separation has not yet occurred.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: A sending HCP cancels a previously sent patient referral by visiting the office visit page viewing the details of a previously sent patient referral and choosing cancel.
requirement_text_raw: A sending HCP cancels a previously sent patient referral by visiting the office visit page  viewing the details of a previously sent patient referral   and choosing cancel.
user_story: As a sending HCP, I want to cancel a previously sent patient referral from its details on the office visit page, so that the referral is withdrawn.
technical_task: Add a cancel option on the details of a previously sent patient referral on the office visit page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a previously sent patient referral on the office visit page, when the sending HCP views its details, then a cancel option is shown.
Given the referral details, when the sending HCP chooses cancel, then the referral is cancelled.

requirement_text: Memory shall be chosen of a family which allows upgrade to larger memory capacity with the same footprint and processor interface.
user_story: As a hardware designer, I want memory from a family that allows an upgrade to larger capacity with the same footprint and processor interface, so that I can upgrade later.
technical_task: Select a memory family that supports larger memory capacity with the same footprint and processor interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the chosen memory, when its family is checked, then a larger capacity is available in that family.
Given the larger capacity memory, when it is compared with the chosen one, then it has the same footprint and processor interface.

requirement_text: User shall utilize certain cryptographic techniques for security.
clarification_questions: What data or communication must they protect?

requirement_text: The date entry including conflicting appointments is highlighted in bold (a conflicting appointment is one that has overlap in its appointment duration period with that of at least another appointment of the same user).
user_story: As a scheduler, I want date entries with conflicting appointments highlighted in bold, so that I can spot overlaps.
technical_task: Highlight in bold any date entry that has a conflicting appointment, meaning an appointment whose duration overlaps another appointment of the same user.
acceptance_criteria: Given two appointments of the same user whose durations overlap, when the dates are displayed, then the date entry is in bold.
Given appointments of the same user that do not overlap, when the dates are displayed, then the date entry is not in bold.

requirement_text: Fee shall be paid by students and verified by the admin.
user_story: As an admin, I want students to pay a fee that I verify, so that payments are confirmed.
technical_task: Allow students to pay the fee and let the admin verify the payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student, when the student pays the fee, then the payment is recorded.
Given a recorded payment, when the admin verifies it, then it is marked as verified.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to learn and master the system within 2 to 4 hours.
user_story: As a new user, I want to learn and master the system within 2 to 4 hours, so that I can start working quickly.
technical_task: Design the system so that a user can learn and master it within 2 to 4 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the user works through the system, then the user can learn it within 2 to 4 hours.
Given a user after 2 to 4 hours of use, when the user performs the main tasks, then the user can do so without help.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. "Master" is not defined, so the second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: User shall restrict communications between some areas of the program for security.
rationale: "Some areas" are not named, so the restriction cannot be specified.
clarification_questions: Which areas of the program should communicate only in a restricted way?
Who sets the restriction and how?

requirement_text: A time-out period shall be started when 3 NEs have joined in.
requirement_text_raw: A time-out period shall (3.2.2.3.3) be started when 3 NEs have joined in.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a time-out period to start when 3 NEs have joined in, so that the system does not wait indefinitely for others.
technical_task: Start a time-out period when 3 NEs have joined in.
acceptance_criteria: Given NEs are joining, when the third NE has joined in, then the time-out period starts.
Given fewer than 3 NEs have joined in, when time passes, then the time-out period has not started.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The benefit is inferred.

requirement_text: It shall be compatible with Windows 8 and Mac X operating systems.
user_story: As a user, I want the application to be compatible with Windows 8 and Mac X, so that I can use it on my computer.
technical_task: Support the Windows 8 and Mac X operating systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a computer running Windows 8, when the application is installed and used, then it works.
Given a computer running Mac X, when the application is installed and used, then it works.

requirement_text: User shall be able to send money by entering recipient's mobile number, email ID, or name, and providing recipient's account number and the amount.
user_story: As a customer, I want to send money by entering the recipient's mobile number, email ID or name together with the account number and amount, so that the recipient receives it.
technical_task: Implement a money transfer that identifies the recipient by mobile number, email ID or name and takes the recipient's account number and the amount.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recipient's mobile number, email ID or name, plus the account number and amount, when the user sends the money, then the transfer is made.
Given a missing account number or amount, when the user tries to send money, then the transfer is not made.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The CND shall provide its registration identity, when it requires the registration to the network.
user_story: As a network operator, I want the CND to provide its registration identity when it requires registration to the network, so that the network can identify it.
technical_task: Make the CND provide its registration identity whenever it requires registration to the network.
acceptance_criteria: Given the CND requires registration to the network, when it registers, then it provides its registration identity.
Given the CND does not require registration, when it connects, then no registration identity is requested.
rationale: Role assumed: network operator. What CND stands for is not given.

requirement_text: User shall be able to start a game once two users are connected.
user_story: As a player, I want to start a game once two users are connected, so that we can play together.
technical_task: Allow a game to be started when two users are connected.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users are connected, when a user starts a game, then the game starts.
Given only one user is connected, when a user tries to start a game, then the game does not start.
rationale: Role assumed: player. The second criterion follows from "once two users are connected".

requirement_text: In the Add New Person dialog box select a type and enter their name and address.
requirement_text_raw: In the Add New Person dialog box  select a type  and enter their name and address.
user_story: As a receptionist, I want to select a type and enter a name and address in the Add New Person dialog box, so that I can add a person.
technical_task: Provide an Add New Person dialog box with a type selection and fields for name and address.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Add New Person dialog box, when the user selects a type and enters a name and address, then the person is added.
Given the dialog box, when it is opened, then it offers a type selection and name and address fields.

requirement_text: User shall have a spreadsheet hosted within Neurohub for collaborative editing and cost calculation.
user_story: As a researcher, I want a spreadsheet hosted within Neurohub for collaborative editing and cost calculation, so that my team can work on costs together.
technical_task: Host a spreadsheet within Neurohub that supports collaborative editing and cost calculation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a spreadsheet in Neurohub, when two users edit it, then both can edit it collaboratively.
Given cost values in the spreadsheet, when a user calculates costs, then the cost calculation is available in the spreadsheet.

requirement_text: System shall provide help material accessible in both offline and online modes.
user_story: As a user, I want help material to be available both offline and online, so that I can get help without a connection.
technical_task: Provide help material that can be opened in both offline and online modes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is online, when the user opens help, then the help material is shown.
Given the system is offline, when the user opens help, then the help material is shown.

requirement_text: The common set of features is shared between all telematics generations (Telematic) of the OEM.
rationale: The sentence states a fact about shared features without a testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which features make up the common set?
What does the requirement ask the system or the supplier to do?

requirement_text: Broker user shall be able to submit records for individual recipients without receiving a DUNS error.
user_story: As a broker, I want to submit records for individual recipients without receiving a DUNS error, so that my submissions are accepted.
technical_task: Allow broker users to submit records for individual recipients without the DUNS error being raised.
acceptance_criteria: Given a broker user and a record for an individual recipient, when the record is submitted, then it is accepted without a DUNS error.
Given an individual recipient without a DUNS number, when the broker submits the record, then no DUNS error is shown.
rationale: Role stated: broker. Why a DUNS error would occur is not described.

requirement_text: Audit trail data must be available for inspection and export for specified cases.
user_story: As an auditor, I want audit trail data to be available for inspection and export for specified cases, so that I can review what happened.
technical_task: Make audit trail data available for inspection and export for specified cases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified case, when the auditor inspects it, then the audit trail data is available.
Given a specified case, when the auditor exports it, then the audit trail data is exported.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. The specified cases are not listed.
